sense: a small piece broken or cut off

evidence: Plin. NH 16.54: assula tenuis brevisque (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: A chip or splinter of wood, and of marble (Vitr.). Potato chips are crisps or French fries (see those); a computer chip has no record here.
Any piece broken off, of tiles, bread or glass; mostly plural.

phrases.latin: at etiam cessō foribus facere hīsce assulās
phrases.english: and here I am, still holding back from smashing this door to splinters

phrases.latin: Faber lignārius asciat asciā māteriam, unde cadunt assulae
phrases.english: The carpenter hews the timber with the adze, and chips fall from it

sources: Lewis & Short: assula · Lewis & Short: fragmentum
